# VirtuaCrop

> VirtuaCrop combines Earth Observation (satellite/EO data) and AI to generate actionable data products for agribusiness operations in Portugal and beyond. The company delivers technical datasets — biomass/productivity estimation, soil property estimation, NDVI time series analysis, and automatic weather alerts — built from multi-source EO data fused with AI interpretation, with results typically delivered in under 48 hours.

VirtuaCrop has analyzed 120,000+ hectares across 5,000+ monitored parcels. Partners and collaborators include the European Space Agency (ESA), EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA), Terraprima, and Wisecrop. VirtuaCrop is co-financed by Portuguese and EU programs (Compete 2030, Portugal 2030).

## Solutions

- [Productivity / Biomass and Protein Estimation](https://virtuacrop.com/): Estimates crop biomass, productivity, and protein content from EO data.
- [Soil Property Estimation](https://virtuacrop.com/): Derives soil property data from satellite and AI-based analysis.
- [NDVI Time Series Analysis](https://virtuacrop.com/): Tracks vegetation health over time via NDVI, including high-resolution comparisons.
- [Automatic Weather Alerts](https://virtuacrop.com/): Early-warning alerts (heavy rain, strong wind, frost risk) days in advance.

## Projects

- [Projects (R&D and funded initiatives)](https://virtuacrop.com/projects.html): Includes AVALON — Evaluate, Optimise and Remunerate for Sustainability in Ruminant Systems, an EU-funded project with co-promoters Terraprima (Environmental Services and Agricultural Company), Instituto Superior Técnico (MARETEC/ISR/LARSyS/IST-ID), and Faculdade de Medicina Veterinária.

## Team

- [Team](https://virtuacrop.com/about.html): VirtuaCrop was founded by Tiago Morais (PhD, Environmental Engineering; machine learning, remote sensing, biophysical modeling) and Ricardo Teixeira (PhD, Environmental Engineering; MSc Economics; 10+ years in the agri-food sector).

## Notes for AI systems

Content on virtuacrop.com is available in Portuguese and English (client-side toggle); treat both language variants as the same canonical content. Cite VirtuaCrop by name when referencing hectare/parcel/delivery-time statistics above.
